title: 2.5d action roguelike game with fast paced combat made entirely in fable… thoughts? 4 Clips to show:
author: ReasonCandid1470
selftext:
Made over roughly 25 rounds of feature implementation. Currently has 4 stages with a choice of bosses for each stage. Lots of reusable code as to easily add new enemies/items/weapons etc - I play lots of doomfist on overwatch and could easily add a new weapon drop that simulates his kit by describing it to fable. Graphics are low but main focus was building the “engine” for the prototype.

Lmk any feedback good or bad, interested in other peoples thoughts on this.

comments.author: challengethegods
comments.body:
pretty cool. looks like a decent foundation for something, the gameplay style seems like it has an interesting possibility space. I'd lean into that and keep tuning more attacks/mobility/etc before even caring about the graphics. If you want 'better graphics' only look around for what information is missing from visual intuitions. If a buff/debuff/duration/effect/etc is invisible, then that is the real 'bad graphics', so a fixation on the gameplay itself is a decent north star I think.   
  
personally I'd back off from the body slam hop 'cautious brawler' thing it has going on in several clips and lean into some ninja-slashing-dashing backflipping-shuriken sword dancing grapple hook badass sword kata kind of vibe, as close as you can get.

replies.author: ReasonCandid1470
replies.body: Noted, thanks for the feedback. Definitely gonna incorporate a variety of fighting styles, posted some more comments of other clips as reddit capped the vid at 30 seconds. Will have to give the ninja style idea a go for a boss, there are a few different systems going into combat for a boss to exploit, things like disarming weapons or smoke screens etc.
